components.name: Load Balancer
components.purpose: Distributes incoming requests across API servers.

components.name: API Server
components.purpose: Handles URL shortening and redirect requests.

components.name: URL Service
components.purpose: Generates short URLs and manages URL mappings.

components.name: ID Generator
components.purpose: Generates globally unique IDs for new URLs.

components.name: Base62 Encoder
components.purpose: Encodes unique IDs into compact Base62 short codes.

components.name: Redis
components.purpose: Caches frequently accessed short URL mappings.

components.name: Database
components.purpose: Stores short URL mappings and metadata.

components.name: Analytics Service
components.purpose: Processes click events and usage statistics asynchronously.

components.name: Message Queue
components.purpose: Buffers analytics events without impacting redirect latency.

components.name: CDN
components.purpose: Caches redirect responses closer to users.
